name: T. Jackman
story: Getting it all together with GIS: first National Multi-Disciplinary GIS Conference, Wellington, 26 to 28 June 1989, edited by T. Jackman and published by ERA Group, records the meeting’s papers.
The proceedings document the First National Multi-Disciplinary GIS Conference in Wellington, 26–28 June 1989, Getting it all together with GIS, edited by T. Jackman and published by ERA Group.
